messages.subject: All my shiny apps are now getting 'ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS' message
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am hosting 20 + applications with my Shiny App account. I haven't make any changes to any of my apps recently. This afternoon I was trying to go to an App which I haven't visited for couple weeks and got an error message like below:


Then I tried to test some of my other apps, at that time, some of them still working while others have the same issues. I was searching online to see what caused this problem. I don't have any redirects on my web apps (at least I didn't intent to do any redirects, not sure if there might be some problem in the backend). Also I have cleared all my cookies, changed browser, changed internet, asked other people to try the url - all didn't work.

Then I tried to open the apps which was still working when I was testing around the first time, however, those apps didn't work either. Basically almost all of my apps are facing the same error message now.

Could anyone help me to understand what cause this problem and if there's any solution I can do here? 

an example url to try: https://viacom-asii.shinyapps.io/Comedy_Central_DNA/ 



Much appreciate here!

Best,
Ice
